# PricingTry for free, scale intentionally.

No surprises, no gotchas—just transparent pricing that grows with your membership.

## Standard

$49 / month+ 4.9% transaction fee

Access everything Memberful has to offer for one monthly price. Try it for free for as long as you like. You'll only be charged when you go live and start accepting payments.

## Enterprise

Custom Pricing

Dedicated support and the flexibility to build exactly what your members deserve. Tell us about your vision, and we'll show you what's possible.

Access to premium services and success management

Custom migration and implementation support
